reviews.text: Carola is a wonderful doctor! Thank God we met!!!

I'm writing this review to thank Carola and her team above all for their professionalism, their ability to understand the problem, and their understanding of its importance. They didn't try to further distress our cat Roi. Their empathy and support throughout the grieving process have been impeccable. You've always been a great help with Mia.

Thank you so much; your professionalism and dedication are evident.

Àngels

I took my cat in because I suddenly noticed sores on his ears. They treated him very well and gave us a quick diagnosis (otitis). It wasn't easy to get him treated, but he's much better now. At the follow-up visit, they examined him thoroughly as well, and he's almost completely healed.

Thank you so much to the vet! ☺️ Great price and great care for the cat! ✨
The receptionist was very friendly. The veterinarian did not want to see us even though there were no patients at the time and we had an emergency. It was very unpleasant.

I’ve been going here for 4 years, since my dog was a puppy. I’m super happy with them- they are kind, love my dog, knowledgeable and they speak English. I highly recommend them. I moved an hour away and still go there bc they’re so good.
So sweet, helpful & understanding!

SaluVet has been our vet for three years now, for my cat Koweït. We've had several doctors there, and we always leave happy. We walk into the examination room, and they immediately let him out of his carrier to explore. They're very careful and patient with him when he doesn't want to be handled. The window distracts him while we talk.

They always explain exactly what they're doing. Now that he needs a dental cleaning, they gave me a quote without me even asking, so I'd know how much it costs, and they let me think about it at home, never pressuring me to do it. They explained the risks of anesthesia and also the risks of leaving him with dirty teeth, and I left feeling reassured. We're getting the cleaning done tomorrow—if they say it's worth it, I trust them.

They're always available for emergencies (if he swallows something he shouldn't or plays with a wasp), and when I have questions at home, they help us via WhatsApp. They also always send me the insurance documents directly, which makes it much easier to request reimbursements.

A good veterinarian can change your life in difficult situations, and I am so grateful to have found this center.

Thank you so much, Tijen Zeynep Bas, for your five-star review! We're delighted to hear that your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona was excellent. We hope to see you again soon. Thank you for trusting us!

I'm so glad I discovered this clinic. They are very professional and truly love what they do. Given my cat's age, it was time for certain tests and procedures that were necessary, and I was able to find out about them thanks to the treatment here. Thank you, Carola and the whole team, and Happy New Year!

Hi Laura! Thank you so much for your five-star review of SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona. We're delighted to hear that your experience with us was excellent. We hope to see you again soon at our center. Thank you for trusting us!
Excellent attention and hairdressing service ♥️

Excellent veterinarian and pet grooming in Barcelona!
I've been bringing my dog to this professional veterinary clinic near my apartment for all his pet care needs, and I couldn't be more satisfied. The veterinarian is an expert and experienced animal doctor who provides caring, compassionate treatment for dogs and cats.
They offer comprehensive veterinary services including pet vaccinations, health checkups, veterinary consultations, microchipping, deworming, flea and tick treatment, spaying and neutering, pet dental care, and general animal care. The vet has modern diagnostic equipment and the clinic facilities are clean and well-maintained.
I also use their pet grooming services - they do fantastic dog grooming and cat grooming with professional pet baths, haircuts, and nail trimming. The grooming salon is spotless and the staff treats animals with genuine affection and care.
What I appreciate most is their affordable and reasonable prices, friendly service, and the fact that they're English-speaking, which is very helpful in Barcelona. Whether you need routine dog vaccinations, cat vaccinations, veterinary medicine, spaying or neutering services, or just quality grooming services for your dog or cat, this is the best vet near me in Barcelona. Highly recommend this trustworthy and reliable veterinary clinic for anyone looking for professional pet care, animal care, and pet grooming services in the area!

I found out about this clinic thanks to a neighbor, shortly before my dog ​​Lucky passed away, and it's such a shame I didn't discover it sooner. Even so, I'm incredibly grateful because I found a wonderful veterinarian.

The clinic's owner, Carola, was always attentive to Lucky and me. Even on holidays, she answered my messages and was incredibly empathetic and helpful. She quickly arranged for an ultrasound machine, expedited tests, and recommended a suitable hospital for the biopsy and follow-up care of his tumor as soon as possible.

Although we only had a short time with them, it gave me immense peace of mind and confidence to know that my Lucky was being cared for professionally and lovingly during such a difficult time. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, not only for their professional expertise but also for their compassion and personalized care, which made a huge difference for both me and my dog.

Thank you so much for your review, Maria! We're delighted to hear that your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona was excellent. We are committed to providing the best care for your pets and hope to see you again soon. Thank you for trusting us!

Excellent service and a very friendly approach when attending to our dog. They also explained everything we needed to know in detail.
A highly recommended place to take your furry friend.

For the past four years, I've trusted this center and its professionals for my dog. Since he was a puppy, we've taken him for all his checkups, vaccinations, emergencies, grooming, etc. And we've always left with a smile of satisfaction, especially knowing what excellent professionals they are—so understanding and attentive.

I have been coming to SaluVet for years, even since I stopped living in Barcelona, ​​and I continue to go there specifically because of the trust I have in Carola. Her treatment is unbeatable: she gives you all the time and attention you need, and you can tell how much she loves our pets. What made me decide to come here, after having tried many vets, was the efficiency and attention she received. My dog ​​Roco had a very uncontrolled allergy outbreak, with many patches on his skin, and she was the only one who knew how to stop it and get him back on his feet. Since then, I have had complete confidence in her🙏🏼

I am the owner of Negreta, delighted with the attention received and the humane treatment, great veterinarian Celia, excellent professional and a person with extraordinary sensitivity, Clara must also be mentioned for her accompaniment and support. The best veterinary center you can go to.
Very good service, very friendly and very professional. They focused on the problem and not on selling me half a store like other places. We were very happy.

Thank you so much, Vlad, for your excellent review! We're delighted to hear that your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona was so positive. We're thrilled to know we met your expectations and hope to see you again soon. Thank you for trusting us!
Excellent service, very attentive and friendly

Hi Alex! Thank you so much for your five-star review. We're delighted to hear that your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona was positive. We're thrilled that you highlighted our service. We hope to see you again soon!
Very professional, attentive, and very loving with our pets, even in the most difficult moments when we sometimes have to make very complicated and painful decisions. 😔🐶❤🌻🌺🌼🌲 Highly recommended. …

By far the best vet in the area. Very professional and kind staff, clean and comfortable office (with an AC! Which apparently isn’t that common here) and the groomer is an artist - every grooming is nothing less than perfect.
We've never been there, but just seeing the comments about Carola makes us really want to bring our cats and meet her :D

Thank you so much, Paola, for your five-star review of SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona! We're delighted to hear you had a wonderful experience with us. We're thrilled you appreciated our service and hope to see you again soon. Thank you for entrusting us with your pet's care!
Had a great experience here with my cat. The vet and staff were all very friendly and diligent. Would recommend!

Salutvet is simply unbeatable. Their team is incredibly professional, attentive, and friendly, always ready to answer questions and provide the best care for pets. The follow-up they do via WhatsApp is incredibly reassuring. Plus, they treat the animals with exceptional kindness. My dog, Rocky, loves going there. Even on Sundays when the clinic is closed, he always wants to pop in and say hello. That says it all! 💙

Without a doubt, this is my go-to clinic, and I recommend them 100%.
The best clinic in the neighborhood! The treatment of humans is impeccable...and even better with the cats!
Good professionals

Since Saluvet opened and we met Carola, we've been absolutely certain that it's the best veterinary care we've ever received. Both she and her team are highly professional, empathetic, and always follow up on our pets' issues. Fantastic!

I'm delighted with SaluVet; the service is incredibly personal. They treat dogs very well and are excellent professionals. My dog ​​got sick, they attended to him quickly, and they even followed up constantly via WhatsApp, which gave me a lot of peace of mind. They are my regular vet and will continue to be.
Excellent service, I will bring my little dog back, thank you

Thank you so much for your review, Carmen Jalon! We're delighted to hear that your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona was excellent. We're happy to know that our team was able to provide you with quality service. We're here to help you whenever you need us. We hope to see you again soon!

Thank you for your excellent review, Ana Lucia García! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed your experience at SaluVet Veterinary Center Barcelona. We are committed to providing the best service to our clients and their pets. We hope to see you again soon!
Our trusted vet for our favorite guy coco!  We’ve been going here for years and they are great.  They treat coco with love every time we go.
Really great and super friendly. You can tell everyone really cares about what they do
Helped us out regarding documents 10/10 great staff
Always very friendly and professional

I took my dog ​​there; she had some rashes on her belly. The vet said it was dermatitis, a type of fungus. She prescribed some medication, and my dog ​​is doing much better now. I was really scared, and they put my mind at ease. This vet also has WhatsApp, and they're really friendly and respond right away when you need them! Highly recommended!
